items.item: The form is split into titled sections (personal, job and contract, bank and tax, emergency contact, documents) in a single column, with a visible label above every field and no placeholder-only labels
items.evidence: Sections are titled (h2 'Personal details', 'Job and contract', 'Bank and tax information', 'Emergency contact', 'Documents'). But fieldHtml() renders a plain <label> (inline) followed by the input, so for narrow fields (w-40/w-56/w-28: Date of birth, Marital status, Nationality, Citizen ID number, Mobile phone) the label sits on the same line to the left of the input in the screenshot ('Date of birth * [mm/dd/yyyy]'), not above it. First/Last name and City/Postal code are also placed side by side in a flex pair (data-pair). No placeholder-only labels.

items.item: Required fields are marked consistently, and optional fields are labelled as optional or left unmarked by a stated convention
items.evidence: Required labels get a trailing '*' (aria-hidden) and the page header states '* Required'; optional fields (Marital status, Postal code, Branch, Social insurance number, Work email) are unmarked; optional document shows an 'Optional' badge.

items.item: Field widths match their content: dates, postal codes and tax codes are narrow; inputs use the right types (email, tel, date)
items.evidence: Date inputs w-40, postal w-28, taxCode/account/ID w-56, dependents w-28; types type:'email' (email, workEmail, ecEmail), 'tel' (phone, ecPhone), 'date' (dob, start, probEnd, end), inputmode numeric on IDs.

items.item: An option to save the form as a draft is offered, and saving a draft does not demand every required field
items.evidence: <button id="saveDraft">Save draft</button>; its onclick only calls setSaving/setDirty and toasts 'Draft saved for new employee ...' with no allErrors()/validation call.

items.item: Save and Cancel stay reachable while scrolling (a sticky bar or equivalent), Save is a verb label and is not disabled before submitting
items.evidence: Action bar 'sticky bottom-0' containing Cancel, Save draft and 'Create employee' (type=submit); visible at bottom of first-viewport screenshot; button is only disabled during saving (setSaving); audit sticky-inert applicable 3, no violations.

items.item: Fields validate on blur and on submit; with several errors a summary at the top links to each field and focus moves to the first invalid field
items.evidence: form 'focusout' handler calls validateField(f); submit handler runs allErrors(), renderSummary(list) (links <a data-jump> '{n} fields need attention' when >=3 errors, placed in #summary above the form) and focusId(list[0].id).

items.item: Leaving the page with unsaved input triggers a warning
items.evidence: window 'beforeunload' handler when dirty; plus in-app guard dialog #leaveDlg 'You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?' on nav links and Cancel.

items.item: The document upload states accepted file types and the size limit, lists chosen files with a remove button, and is keyboard operable
items.evidence: Text 'PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 10 MB each.'; renderDocs() table lists file name/size with a Remove button (data-doc="remove", aria-label 'Remove ...'); Upload is a real <button> that triggers a visually hidden file input, 10 MB check in change handler.

items.item: Success is confirmed with a message that names the employee and is announced to assistive technology
items.evidence: On submit success: toast(`Employee NV-2026-0143 (${V.lastName} ${V.firstName}) created. Start date ...`) written into persistent <div role="status" id="toast">; status badge also changes to 'Pending start'.

notes: Audit score 100, no violations. The main miss is label placement: narrow fields show their label inline to the left of the input (label is not display:block), contradicting 'label above every field'; name and city/postal pairs also break the single column. Minor: the summary region is role=status rather than alert, document statuses use small blue/green/red/slate pills (functional, not rainbow). No gradients, glass, emoji, hover-lift, KPI tiles or greeting header.
